rationale: FX02 fired on fair_value_currency with observed value UNIT_USD. The raw schedule's investment table labels the fair value column in dollar terms and shows dollar signs on the total investments line; representative flagged holdings such as K2 Propco have fair values under that Fair Value column. UNIT_USD is therefore the expected USD unit, so the flag is a checker/unit-normalization false alarm rather than a source data error.
